# Lavaland Megafauna
Lavaland is home to a handful of ancient monsters. They are far tougher than anything else on the planet, they hit very hard, and every one of them guards valuable loot. Bring friends, bring a crusher or kinetic accelerator, and bring medicine.
## How They Fight - Megafauna wake up when you walk into their lair or hit them. Their boss music starts playing when they notice you. - Almost every special attack is [color=#ffa500]telegraphed[/color]: tiles flash or flare up just before they deal damage, a shadow marks where something will land, and a red pulse means something is about to charge. Watch the ground and keep moving. - They get [color=#ff5555]angrier[/color] as they take damage. Attacks come faster, and new attacks unlock once a boss is badly hurt. - Fighting with more people makes a boss tougher and more aggressive, so a big group is not a free win. - If everyone runs away, a boss forgets about you and fully heals. Finish the job. - Only the crew can hurt them. Lava, fire and other wildlife will not soften them up for you.
## The Megafauna - [bold]Ash Drake[/bold]: breathes cones of fire, spits fireball volleys and takes to the sky to crash down on whoever its shadow is chasing. When badly hurt it rains fire around you and surrounds itself with an expanding ring of flame. Run from the shadow, then sidestep the shockwave. - [bold]Bubblegum[/bold]: charges in a straight line and plows through anything in the way, leaving a trail of blood. Hands burst out of the ground around its prey. When wounded it charges three times in a row and sinks into the blood to resurface right next to you. Dodge sideways, never backwards. - [bold]Colossus[/bold]: fires spreads of crystal bolts, alternating rings of bolts and, later, spinning spirals and crystal spikes in a cross under you. Near death it unleashes a storm of crimson bolts in every direction. Find the gaps between the bolts. - [bold]Legion[/bold]: releases swarms of skulls, rushes its target and sprays corrosive bile. Killing it splits it into lesser legions. - [bold]Hierophant[/bold]: lives in its own arena. Expanding boxes, crosses and chasing blasts fill the floor in patterns, and it blinks around the arena.
## Elites Lesser, but still dangerous, monsters roam the wastes: - [bold]Legionnaire[/bold]: charges and summons legion skulls. - [bold]Herald[/bold]: fires spreads, rings and spirals of light and teleports around. - [bold]Broodmother[/bold]: grabs prey with goliath tentacles, fills the ground with them and hatches angry broods. - [bold]Pandora[/bold]: a lesser hierophant with the same box and cross patterns.
## Rewards Every megafauna drops a necropolis chest and a unique crusher trophy: - Ash drake: lava aspect blade. Bubblegum: weighted handle and a cursed heart. Colossus: ice frost blade. Legion: sharpness blade. Hierophant: the hierophant club and the kinetic marker. - Elites drop a random crusher upgrade and rare materials.
